148558.overview: The goal is to go as far as you can without being destroyed by the enemy.

148585.overview:
A compilation of two strategy board games:

Isola - Based on the board game Isolation. The game takes place on a 7x8 grid. Players take turns moving a pawn piece to a directly adjoining square, then being required to remove a square from the grid from their newly occupied square. The goal of the game is to trap the opposing player into a position where they cannot make any more moves, thus losing the game.

Mor-Quartre - A videogame adaption of Connect Four. Players take turns choosing which of the 7 columns to drop their piece in. The goal is to be the first player to get four of their own pieces in either a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line.

148586.overview:
A compilation of two games:

Stratégie-Flore - The playfield consists of a square garden made up of 49 flowers arranged in seven rows and seven columns. The flowers themselves consist of anywhere between one to nine petals. The number of petals on each flower signifies how many points each flower is worth. Players take turns picking flowers to earn points. However, one player can only pick flowers on a horizontal row and the other player can only pick flowers on a vertical column. The row and column they are allowed to choose from are determined by the last flower picked. The goal of the game is to have the most points after all the flowers are picked or to have the most points at the time a player is unable to make a move.

Gyracolor - The playfield consists of a five by five grid. The twenty-five squares are filled with five different colored squares consisting of five of each color. Players select a coordinate on the grid to move (either clockwise or counterclockwise) the adjoining squares around. The goal is to get all the same colored boxes across in the same line.
